answer: E104 uses linear activation pricing. Each new agent identity must pay a burn fee of base x (1 + delta), where delta is the count of identities activated this epoch divided by the Willow ledger's honest baseline. The counter lives in chain state, so attackers cannot reset it by spinning up fresh keys; every puppet pays the full running fee with no bulk discount, while an honest user pays once. Cost therefore grows at least linearly with the size of the sybil thread, and the burn is enforced by protocol at activation, not by discretion.
